note: The seed graph. Every node carries the source it came from and whether it is anchored to source bytes. In this release NOTHING is anchored — no primary artefact has been frozen or hashed yet — so every fact reads 'secondary'. That is the honest state of a first MVP and the pages render it as such rather than showing an anchor that does not exist.

unused_node_types.why: The ontology defines Role because obligations attach to duty-holders, but no ingested source names which roles these provisions oblige. Inventing them would be the exact failure this publication exists to report on, so the type stays empty until a primary text supplies it.
